I will load the file and slice the steam section using the header markers.

```python
import pandas as pd
file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/54612da3-fd56-4941-80f4-5eb82330de25.xlsx"
excel = pd.ExcelFile(file_path)
print("Sheets:", excel.sheet_names)
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name=excel.sheet_names[0])
print("Columns:", list(df.columns))
# Find section boundaries
steam_start = df.index[df['Number'] == 'Steam'][0]
diesel_start = df.index[df['Number'] == 'Diesel'][0]
steam_df = df.iloc[steam_start+1:diesel_start]
print("Steam section rows:\n", steam_df)
print("Extracted wheel arrangements:", list(steam_df['Type/Wheel Configuration']))
```
